remarks: 4 bedrooms / 2.5 baths ~ Spacious, sunny and spectacular! This beautifully renovated Colonial offers 4 bedrooms (primary on main with en-suite bath, 3 up), 2.5 baths. The home is privately sited on lush acreage south of the parkway. Tucked away ~ yet close enough to walk to shops & restaurants. The main level finds a large sun-filled living room with picture windows, wood burning fireplace and reading nook, formal dining room, newer gourmet eat-in-kitchen with fireplace features beautiful white granite counter-tops, stainless-steel appliances & pretty cabinets, first floor primary bedroom with indulgent newer en-suite bath, sun/mud room off the kitchen with powder room and laundry closet (newer washer/dryer) completes. Step out back to your private entertainer's stone patio overlooking the abundant wooded oasis. Back inside, the upper level provides 3 bedrooms each featuring a pretty stained-glass accent window & ample closets, along with a newer full bath with shower/tub.  Detached barn/1 car garage, 1 car carport, plenty of off-street parking (room for 5+ cars), charming workshop/studio and sheds add to the rich allure of this fabulous home. Storage galore! Minutes to all Stamford amenities & major routes. Simply, move-in, unpack and enjoy this tranquil gem. Newer; siding, interior painting, hardwood floors, kitchen, baths, laundry, ... makes this a must-see home!
